enemy-035-trilobite-echo.method: Manual pose-by-pose inspection of the single radial basal-ring hub, projected vertically to the observed planted-tentacle support or, after collapse, the central-mantle body contact. The landmark is never a tentacle tip and the terminal death root is never placed under a loose extended limb. Every anchor includes the complete extracted source lower bound and guard pixel, so sourceBounds[3] - anchorY equals zero for all 32 poses. Attack was inspected on the lossless safe-reassignment ownership result because its selected source has proven short boundary spill.
enemy-035-trilobite-echo.visualReview: All 32 source poses and the four marked overlays were inspected. Yellow marks the basal-ring hub, cyan its vertical projection and green the support/body-contact anchor. This is physical registration evidence only: no source was normalized, accepted or integrated.

enemy-036-deacon-line.method: Manual per-pose pelvis-center landmark at the proximal leg junction, vertically projected to the complete extracted support/contact guard required by runtime pivot y=240. Idle/move grounded anchors use y=431; attack uses y=430 except frame 2 at y=429; grounded/contact death uses y=429. Airborne death frames 1-2 intentionally remain on the adjacent y=427 ground plane to preserve fall height. Every non-airborne anchor is therefore >= sourceBounds[3]. Whole-body extrema and the cranial mitre are never used as roots.
enemy-036-deacon-line.visualReview: All 32 source poses and four regenerated marked overlays inspected after the runtime pivot guard audit. Exactly two legs, pelvis placement, planted/contact support, complete extraction guard and inferred airborne ground plane were reviewed. All 30 non-airborne poses satisfy anchorY >= sourceBounds[3]; death frames 1-2 retain y=427 and remain below their source bounds at 421/415. Physical registration only; no artistic acceptance, scale merge, normalization or runtime integration.
